name: Catch me up clears Sent
author: wizard
description: Catch me up also offers every finished chat in Sent, whatever its age, as one line in Clear all ("N finished chats in Sent"); when you answer clear, they are archived, so Sent holds only what is still running or finished since your last catch-up. Clear except N keeps the ones you name. Running chats and chats waiting on you are never cleared. Read by the Agent Service (wizard-agent-service issue 710); nothing in the shell changes until it is on.
